comment.narrative: 1. Achieved. Two strategic documents developed (Technical Framework for Information Society Development Strategy - Ministry of Transport and Communications of BiH and Strategic Framework for Development of Science, Technology and Information Society for Republika Srpska - MNRVOID); 6 Digital Readiness Assessments and Digital Transformation Roadmaps developed; MoU signed with Federal Ministry of Interior, and as is - to be analysis of G2G services in FBiH provided. 2. The score deteriorated due to political instability, COVID 19 and related governance performance. 1. Partially achieved. Full planned delivery impossible due to political constraints, activities adapted towards more analytical and preparatory work. 2. N/A. Relevant index/report for 2021 not yet available. Report has been published for 2022, and recording decrease in Governance index - 3.78. The score deteriorated due to political instability, COVID 19 and related governance performance. This indicator is largely affected by the political and economic developments, and project activities are still to contribute through access to services and overall efficiency of the public sector. 3. Partially achieved. Two services implemented - Economic Diplomacy Platform (Ministry of Foreign Affairs of BiH) and distribution of BAM 60 million subsidies to Covid 19 - affected micro business in Federation of BiH (paperless application, selection and granting of funds - Federal Ministry of Development, Entrepreneurship and Crafts). Four more services identified, analyzed and prepared for design and delivery. In various stages of procurement or implementation. 4. Fully achieved. Through two tailor – made trainings, over 200 public officials and staff from all the levels of government strengthened capacities. A Digital Transformation Academy for the State, Federation of BiH and Republika Srpska levels included 119 participants (75 male and 44 female) and 25 trainers (15 male and 10 female). A Public Sector Innovation training gathered 57 participants (27 male and 30 female) and 15 trainers (5 male and 10 female). Altogether, 216 participants took part - 122 male and 94 female (43%). 5. Achieved. A series of preparatory activities was implemented, leading to conceptualizing and preparing e services. 6 Digital Readiness Assessments and Digital Roadmaps were conducted and designed, including over 50 government representatives; a MoU on G2G services was signed with Federal Ministry of Interior, together with as is – to be analysis; Public Sector Innovation included a Policy Lab simulation for 36 civil servants/officials from various government levels. On citizens’ side, a tool for public consultations was deployed to Directorate for EU integrations, 2 e-service portals are in development (Canton Sarajevo and Municipality Centar Sarajevo) based on a strong citizen-centric design approach. 6. Achieved. Through e-service developed for Federal Ministry of Entrepreneurship, Development and Crafts, 53,000 citizens (owners or employees of micro business in Federation of BiH) were able to interact and ensure they are listed and evaluated for COVID – 19 relief subsidies. This service, delivered fully electronically and through automated process, recorded 269.464 interactions by citizens. . 7. Achieved. Though activity with the Federal Ministry of Entrepreneurship, Development and Crafts, a fully transactional e-service for distribution of COVID-19 relief subsidies was realized. It included distribution of BAM 60 million to 24,800 to micro businesses in Federation of BiH. 8. Achieved. On December 31, 78 registered members of the Network. Due to the fact that the Digital Community platform is under development, gender disaggregated data are not available in full – confirmed part is amounting to 82 male and 57 female members. 9. Achieved. Due to the COVID 19 restrictions, organization of events was limited to the beginning of 2022 (Q4). One DigiTalk event organized on 19 November 2021 (What Bosnia and Herzegovina can learn from United Kingdom) with 80 participants, and two trainings available to Network members (Digital transformation Academy and Public Sector Innovation Training) – 216 participants. With FCDO, a training Introduction to Agile in Government organized for 30 participants. Additionally, in cooperation with USAID, Network members were able to take part in the series of e-governance related trainings organized by E-Governance Activity project throughout 2021. 10. Partially achieved - postponed for the next year.
